measurement_contract.decision_latency: For every delivered measured attempt, start at adapter receipt and stop at the first terminal application response. Include ALLOW, LIMITED, and error responses. If the caller cancels first, use cancellation time and count it as a failure; if no response arrives by deadline, use that deadline duration as the latency sample. Compute nearest-rank percentiles over all delivered attempts; do not filter errors, cancellations, or timeouts.
